description: Search what SynthHub users shared (CC BY-SA 4.0): sounds, sequences, kits, projects, banks, MIDI clips. Filter by device, kind, category, genre, tag, author (pseudonym) or words; sort by newest, most stars, most loaded into a device or most trusted (confirmed on real devices). Returns, per preset, its id, name, kind, device, description, author, version, whether it has device data, settings, a MIDI file or an audio preview (URL), and its counts. Get one with get_preset.

device.description: Driver id or slug (its other variants are included).

offset.description: Skip this many: the next page (the reply's total says how many match).

query.description: Words that must all appear in the name, description, tags, genres, category or device id ('dx7 piano').

sort.description: new (default), most stars, most loaded into a device, or most confirmed on real devices.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: find_presets
